Detection changes arrive as pull requests with the reasoning attached. Own the signal quality problem end to end. Tune what's noisy, retire what's dead, and know which gaps are deliberate. The measure is how much of an investigation is already done by the time a person opens it. Bring threat intelligence into the practice with an output attached: adversary tradecraft translated into detection use cases, hunts, or control changes. Advance the program's metrics: coverage against the threat model, escalation quality from the provider, time to detect and time to close, reported in terms leadership steers by. Hunt on a schedule. Structured hypotheses against our own telemetry, and every finding either becomes a detection or gets written down as a deliberate gap.
